channel.title: RestockRally
channel.description: Fast sneaker release dates, restocks and raffles

item.title: Kobe 8 Protro "Shanghai Fireworks" returns November 11 for $200
item.description: Nike's SNKRS page lists the Kobe 8 Protro Shanghai Fireworks, style code IO6259-800, for November 11 at $200, with a Big Kids' listing at $125.

item.title: Women's Air Jordan 11 "Magic Ball" launches November 11 at $235
item.description: Nike's SNKRS page lists the women's Air Jordan 11 Magic Ball, style code IZ1800-200, for November 11 at $235, with a Space Jam theme.

item.title: Nike Air Force 1 Low Premium "What the LA" drops November 5
item.description: Nike's SNKRS page lists the Air Force 1 Low Premium What the LA, style code CT1117-100, for November 5 at $125, inspired by Los Angeles sports.

item.title: Nike Blazy "Tie Dye" and women's Air Max Dolce Leather launch November 4
item.description: Nike's SNKRS pages list the Blazy Tie Dye at $105 and the women's Air Max Dolce Leather in Black and Natural at $170 for November 4.

item.title: Sneaker releases November 8 to 14, 2026: Kobe 8, Magic Ball AJ11, Air Max 95 and 90
item.description: Nike's SNKRS pages list a Big Bubble Air Max 95, a Mind 002 Flyknit, the Kobe 8 Shanghai Fireworks, a Magic Ball AJ11, an Air Bakin and two Air Max 90s.

item.title: How to spot a fake sneaker release ad or raffle
item.description: FTC advice applied to sneaker drops: go to the retailer's own site, distrust deep discounts, pay by credit card and never pay to enter a raffle.

item.title: Kobe 3 Low Protro "Mamba Eterno" and Kobe Dunk Low Protro launch October 30
item.description: Nike's SNKRS pages list the Kobe 3 Low Protro Mamba Eterno at $190 and the Kobe Dunk Low Protro Anthracite and Sundial at $130 for October 30.

item.title: Nike Air Max 97 HBCU marching band pack: Coppin State, NC A&T and MVSU on October 30
item.description: Nike lists three Air Max 97s inspired by HBCU marching band uniforms for October 30 at $190 each, with school colors and a matching whistle.

item.title: Air Jordan 14 "Forest Green" returns October 31 for $215
item.description: Nike's SNKRS page lists the Air Jordan 14 Forest Green, style code 487471-300, for October 31 at $215, its first return since 2005.

item.title: Sneaker releases next week: November 1 to 7, 2026
item.description: Kobe 3 Low Black, Pharrell's Adistar Jellyfish, a Foamposite college pack, Union's Bamboo Dunk and the Air Jordan 6 White Infrared lead November 1 to 7.

item.title: One Block Down Nike Air Max 95 Big Bubble Lux is listed for November 6 at $200
item.description: Nike's SNKRS page lists the One Block Down Air Max 95 Big Bubble Lux, style code IM0704-001, for November 6 at $200.

item.title: Air Max Foamdome "Eggplant" and Jordan 11 MCS "Space Jam" cleat set for November 5
item.description: Nike's SNKRS pages list the Air Max Foamdome Eggplant at $265 and the Jordan 11 MCS Space Jam baseball cleat at $225 for November 5.

item.title: How Nike SNKRS Draw and Line launches work
item.description: Nike's SNKRS 101 page explains Draw, a random pick after entries close, and Line, which works like a queue.

item.title: adidas Originals by Wales Bonner lists Fall/Winter 2026 for October 29
item.description: Wales Bonner's page sets the Fall/Winter 2026 collection for October 29 at 9:00 AM GMT. adidas lists the Black Pony at $200.

item.title: Converse SHAI 001 Lace Up "Flare" is listed for October 29 at $120
item.description: Nike's SNKRS page lists the SHAI 001 Lace Up Flare, style code A23933C-832, for October 29 at $120.

item.title: Every Air Jordan releasing in November 2026
item.description: Space Jam Air Jordan 11s, the Air Jordan 6 White Infrared and the Air Jordan 4 Bred lead Jordan Brand's November 2026 lineup.

item.title: Air Jordan 4 "Bred" returns November 27 for $230
item.description: The Air Jordan 4 Bred is listed for November 27, 2026 at $230, returning with its original materials.

item.title: Sneaker releases today and tomorrow: October 28 and 29, 2026
item.description: The Air Max Ecstasy Plus drops October 28, then a college Air Force 1 pack, Wales Bonner adidas and the New Balance 992 land October 29.

item.title: Air Jordan 3 "Fireside": where to buy on October 30
item.description: The women's Air Jordan 3 Fireside drops October 30 at 10 AM ET for $205 on SNKRS. Here is how it sells and where.

item.title: Nike Foamposite releases in November 2026: Mummy Duck, college pack and Dr. Doom
item.description: Nike has at least six Foamposite pairs on the November 2026 calendar, from the Mummy Duck on November 3 to the Dr. Doom on November 27.

item.title: Sneaker releases this week: October 27 to 31, 2026
item.description: The Air Jordan 3 Fireside, Kobe Mamba Eterno pack, Air Jordan 14 Forest Green and more land between October 27 and 31.

item.title: Air Jordan 6 "White Infrared" returns November 7 for $215
item.description: Nike's SNKRS page lists the Air Jordan 6 White Infrared, style code CT8529-105, for November 7 at $215.

item.title: Air Jordan 11 "Green Screen" set for November 14 at $255
item.description: Nike lists the Air Jordan 11 Green Screen, inspired by Space Jam's green screens, for November 14 at $255.

item.title: Nike LeBron XXIV "Stars" debuts November 17 for $180
item.description: Nike says the LeBron XXIV is the lightest LeBron signature shoe yet. The Stars colorway arrives November 17 for $180.

item.title: October restocks: Nike Mind, Air Bakin and Air Max Phenomena came back
item.description: Nike Mind 001 and 002, the Air Bakin High SP and the Air Max Phenomena all restocked in October 2026. Here is what came back and where.
